children: Overview
China rare disease drugmaker's H1 revenue rose 25.6% yr/yr, driven by Hunterase and Livmarli sales
Company reported progress in drug pipeline and business operations during the reporting period
Research and development expenses fell 30.5%, mainly due to lower operational costs and project timing
Outlook
Company did not provide specific guidance or forecasts for future quarters or full year in the press release
Result Drivers
HUNTERASE AND LIVMARLI SALES - Co said revenue growth was mainly driven by increased sales of Hunterase and Livmarli
LOWER R&D EXPENSES - Co said research and development expenses fell due to lower operational costs and timing of clinical trials
LEASE TERMINATION GAINS - Co recognized gains from early termination of US lease property, credited to profit for the period
